selection: Read saved root profiles once. For each outcome and total step0..6, select the least-index root with the largest positive saved coefficient. These scans use retained coefficients; no recurrence, redex search or contraction.
queries: For each nonempty group: saved count, root/prefix condition and readable terms with duplicate requests avoided. Select unique ranks0,floor(count/2),count-1 and inversely rank each full path. For each nonempty selected history, condition on a deterministic first-half prefix, rank that path within the prefix family, and select back.
semantics: Exact occurrence-address histories at a fixed root/outcome/total steps. Global and conditional ranks are zero-based. Empty normal histories at step0 are valid.
banking: Request before invocation; full response and current reader caches/work after each successful call. Retain pending request/error and stop on failure. Whole reader checkpoint before publication.
exclusions: No constructor, source example, term-reduction, redex, coefficient or prior proof replay. Rendering reads saved immutable syntax only.
